lines.en: I drag my legs forward.
Every step comes with a wheeze.

lines.zh: 粉色的烟从我嘴里漏出来
lines.en: Pink smoke leaks from my mouth.
I'm slow, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 烟气在我身后拉成一条
lines.en: The smoke trails behind me.
One shoulder rides higher than the other.
I pull my clothes tighter.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被烟熏得发黄
lines.en: The grass yellows where my smoke passes.
I cough as I walk and can't stop.
My lungs feel stuffed with wet cotton.
I rest against a tree a moment.
A few steps more and the smoke thickens.
I stand, chest heaving.
Pink smoke curls around me.
I cough out a small cloud.
This body should have rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指缝里全是粉色的烟。
lines.en: I raise my hand; pink smoke seeps between my fingers.
The wood is close and still. Good.
I take a breath and get only smoke.

lines.zh: 我靠着一块石头慢慢缓
lines.en: I lean on a stone and settle.
Footsteps nearby. I listen.
The wind will carry the smoke over.
I look at you, and wheeze first.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，你会吸进去
lines.en: Don't stand so near; you'll breathe it.

lines.zh: 粉色的烟在我嘴边打转
lines.en: Pink smoke curls at my lips.
You look strong.
I turn slowly toward you.
You're covering your mouth. Too late.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛半睁着，看不清
lines.en: My eyes are half shut and blurry.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，就我们两个
lines.en: Just the two of us in this wood.
The closer you come, the thicker it gets.
I know your breathing will go shallow.
The blow bends me double, coughing.
The smoke scatters, then gathers.
My breath grows shorter.
A sharp pain in my lungs.
I hold the tree to stay up.
That hit makes my wheezing louder.
I can't keep my mouth shut.
Smoke seeps from the wound.
You hit quite hard.
But I'm not down yet.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，我闻不清
lines.en: I can't smell that thing clearly.
The smoke blocks my sense of smell.
I come closer just to look.
Just set it down. Don't come close.
You're holding your breath; your face is red.
I won't snatch. I just want to breathe.
Food is of little use to me now.
Back off a bit and I'll come over.
The smoke has buried that smell.
What is it you're holding?
You ram me and the smoke thickens.
I give half a step and wheeze harder.
You've stepped into the smoke; your eyes will sting.
Don't shove me. My footing isn't good.
That bump set me coughing.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞在你的胸口
lines.en: My shoulder meets your chest.

lines.zh: 你被推开，手上沾了烟灰
lines.en: You're pushed back, ash on your hands.
Smoke rises between us.
Closer and you'll be breathing it.
Two steps back and I'll hold off.
Don't breathe this breath of mine.
Stand behind me; the wind blows forward.
When I cough, keep your distance.

lines.zh: 这具身体烂得差不多了
lines.en: This body is nearly gone.
You still want to come closer?
I won't say pretty things.

lines.zh: 粉烟里，我们也能走一段
lines.en: We can walk a while inside pink smoke.

lines.zh: 你替我看着风，我替你看着路
lines.en: You watch the wind; I'll watch the road.
Don't stay too long. I'll start coughing.
Walk slowly with me on this road.
I bend down and my lungs rattle.
Can't see through the smoke; I felt it.
I pick it up and cough twice.
I'll take this. Don't come near.

lines.zh: 这截东西，塞进我破洞的口袋。
lines.en: This goes into my torn pocket.
Is it useful? I don't know either.
You dropped it at my feet.
Picking things up is too much effort.
I drag it a few steps.
We'll sort it later. Stow it for now.

lines.zh: 你吸进去了，第一步成了
lines.en: You breathed it in. Step one done.
I see you, and I won't let it pass.
The smoke goes first. I follow.
Your strength is draining.
I open my mouth wider.
Close enough. No chase needed.
Upwind won't save you.
I'll walk over, step by step.
Target set. Take it slow.
Your hands are already going slack.
Don't hold your breath. You can't.
Now you're mine.
My smoke will follow you.
Do you hear me wheezing?
Let's begin. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我用不着跑，你也跑不掉
lines.en: I needn't run, and neither can you.

lines.zh: 我一步步走近，烟在前面
lines.en: I walk forward, smoke leading.
You've backed to a tree.

lines.zh: 烟钻进你的胸口，你咳得弯下腰。
lines.en: The smoke enters your chest; you double over coughing.

lines.zh: 粉烟从你的脚下绕上去
lines.en: Pink smoke curls up around your feet.
You raise a hand against the smoke; now it's empty.
I'm in no hurry. I have all day.
Every breath you take weakens you.
My strength is small, but enough.

lines.zh: 你在找上风处，我看见了
lines.en: You're looking for upwind. I see.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，粉色烟气从背后飘。
lines.en: I turn sideways, pink smoke drifting from behind me.
This cloud won't disperse.

lines.zh: 你听得见自己的心跳吗
lines.en: Can you hear your own heartbeat?
I raise my hand, slowly.
One step closer. That's it.
You won't last much longer.
The smoke is on your face now.
I'm waiting for your knees to buckle.

lines.zh: 你的指尖在抖，烟已经起效了。
lines.en: Your fingertips tremble; the smoke is working.
Don't bother running. You can't.
This breath is for you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，慢得像在打招呼
lines.en: I raise a hand, slow as a greeting.

lines.zh: 这一抓落在你的肩甲上
lines.en: The grab lands on your shoulder plate.
Pink smoke blows straight into your face.
Your knees give and I lean in.

lines.zh: 我的力气不大，你没力气躲
lines.en: I'm weak, but you're too weak to dodge.
You're pushed back against a tree.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，一大团烟散开
lines.en: I cough and a big cloud bursts out.
This one goes for your wrist.
You can't hold the sword now.
Pink smoke sprays straight at your face.
Your punches are much lighter.
Smoke hits your lungs and you start coughing.
I press down on your shoulder.
You pull back; I wheeze after you.
This breath weighs more than a blade.
Just a little longer now.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的护膝
lines.en: My fingers hook your knee guard.
The push is light, yet you fall back.

lines.zh: 烟把我藏起来，你打空了
lines.en: The smoke hides me; your swing misses.
Coughing, you leave me a step to close.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，一步一步
lines.en: I walk out of the haze, step by step.
First comes a fit of coughing.
Pink smoke reaches out ahead of me.
The damp wood holds smoke well.
My clothes are riddled with holes.
I steady myself on a tree and stand.

lines.zh: 肺里的东西，我不想细说
lines.en: I won't describe what's in my lungs.
Someone nearby is breathing.
I'll walk slowly that way.
The wind comes from over there.
People here will smell me first.

lines.zh: 跑步从来不是我的强项
lines.en: Running was never my strong point.

lines.zh: 火一沾，我整个人开始烧
lines.en: Fire touches me and I burn all over.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我的肋骨折了
lines.en: I hit the ground and my ribs break.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我咳不出来
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I can't cough it out.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的烟全吹散了
lines.en: The blast blows my smoke apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的胸口，烟漏得更多
lines.en: An arrow through my chest lets more smoke out.
That light presses on my lungs.
Too starved even to stand easily.
Lightning hits me and I lock in place.
Wheezing, I fall and fall.
